item.title: NT Daily 11/5: Historic Jefferson City Election Upset, Holiday Happenings & Fall Sports Playoffs | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: On today's NT Daily, we recap the historic election upset in Jefferson City, where Democrat Suzanne Luther defeated Republican Shane Kampeter to flip House District 60 for the first time in decades. News Tribune reporter Jack Wardynski speaks with Luther about her victory, the issues that resonated with voters and her priorities heading into the legislative session. Plus, a quick look at what's happening around Jefferson City beyond the election: The Salvation Army prepares to launch its annual Red Kettle Campaign. JC Parks introduces a new holiday tradition at the River Market. Capital Arts opens its annual holiday gift exhibition featuring local artists. Jefferson City searches for a new operator for the Capital Region Amphitheater. And in sports, Helias volleyball heads to the Class 4 Final Four, Jefferson City and Capital City face off in district soccer, and local football and cross country teams continue postseason competition. Today's episode is brought to you by MU Health Care, Hen House and Coleman Appliance. Get the full stories and the latest local news at newstribune.com. Thanks for watching NT Daily!
